item.title: Traffic management plan in place for Culdaff water works - Highland Radio - Latest Donegal News and Sport
item.description: Mains repair works may cause supply disruptions to Culdaff and surrounding areas. Works are scheduled to take place until 2pm this afternoon. A traffic management plan will be in place for the duration of these works. Uisce Eireann recommends that those affected allow 3-4 hours after the estimated restoration time for supply to fully return.
